purpose: Pins the ARIEC61850 engine used by ARSAS. PR #76 preserves every mandatory static DataSet member, including unresolved object-level FCD members without inventing .stVal. PR #77 canonicalizes SCL DataSet member identity across logical devices so parser display references such as IED/LD/LN.DO [FC] resolve to the same IEDLD/LN.DO identity used by the live model.
